newsitem.title: USA: U.S. asks for tough sentence for tough judge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. asks for tough sentence for tough judge.

text.p: A state judge known as "Iron Mike" for his tough sentencing pleaded guilty Wednesday to tax evasion and a federal prosecutor said the judge should be given as tough a sentence as he used to hand out.

Former Superior Court Judge Michael Imbriani, 67, avoided prison last year in a plea bargain arising from charges he embezzled $173,000 from his partners in a medical arts building in Bound Brook, N.J.
He faces possible disbarment after a hearing next week on his future status as an attorney.
Imbriani's plea was to one count of evading federal income taxes on $50,000 of the illicit income.
U.S. Attorney Faith Hochberg noted that Imbriani was very tough on white-collar crime and "that the position he set should be applied by this court as well." Sentencing was set for Dec. 11.
